in_marathi.name: Gajaadhar
in_marathi.long_meaning: Gajaadhar हे एक हिंदू नाव आहे जे भारतीय संस्कृतीत खोल आध्यात्मिक महत्त्व ठेवते। Gajaadhar is a Sanskrit name derived from the words 'Gaja' (elephant) and 'Adhara' (holder). This name is associated with the mythological figure Gajendra, who was a human being who was saved from the king of elephants, Indra. The name symbolizes strength, courage, and protection.
